data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, even if others choose 10—not an all-or-nothing deal. Each switch earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k; remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Even at k=25, 50 remain, above collapse, but recovery isn't guaranteed or long-run optimal. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Each Fisher: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Fisher15/17, help recruit?
